boundary_evidence: Contiguous .text span 0x0204d4d0..0x0204d8e8: six functions tile the span exactly with no hole and no tail (recomputed from config/arm9/symbols.txt). They are the six particle behaviours of the NitroSystem particle library (SPL), SPLBehavior_ApplyConvergence .. SPLBehavior_ApplyGravity, whose bodies are, body for body and in reverse emission order, pret pokeplatinum's lib/spl/src/spl_behavior.c (Gravity, Random, Magnet, Spin, CollisionPlane, Convergence). SPLAnim_Scale (spl_anim.c) ends at 0x0204d4d0 below and func_0204d8e8 begins at 0x0204d8e8 above, so the boundary is a file change on both edges -- the linker places one object's .text contiguously, so the behaviour run is its own TU.

notes: The six functions were Particle::<Name>::Func statics of coined POD structs (Acceleration, Jitter, Converge, Turn, LimitPlane, RadiusConverge) over a coined EffectData union. SPL is a C library and every body is the function pret's spl_behavior.c gives the same job, so they are extern "C" SPLBehavior_Apply* over the SPL record types in include/Particle__Behavior.h. The names are pret's coinages, not ROM or SDK symbols. This cartridge's SPL is older than pokeplatinum's: no emitter argument, the spin angle is shifted down four bits into a sine-table index, and the collision plane always uses the record's height.
